neighbours.label: The word that places a person in an office or post: 'serves on/in', 'holds the', 'appointed to', before the named position
fire: Dr. Alvarez now holds the chair of Surgery at the medical college.
After the vote, Ms. Okafor serves on the county planning commission.
Mr. Lund was recently appointed to the role of finance minister.
For six years she has served on the Board of Regents.
General Pryce holds the rank of lieutenant in the reserve.
Their founder currently serves in the state senate.
Professor Hahn was appointed to the deanship in 2014.
Judge Moore now holds the seat vacated by her colleague.
quiet: Dr. Alvarez now holds the ladder while his son paints the barn.
After the vote, Ms. Okafor serves soup at the county fair.
Mr. Lund was recently spotted at the opening of a bakery.
For six years she has walked to the Board Street market.
General Pryce visited the barracks of the reserve in spring.
Their founder currently lives near the state border.
Professor Hahn was thrilled with the weather in 2014.
Judge Moore now owns the house sold by her colleague.

notes: Probes: 'He holds the door' also reads 0.40 on ' the', 'She serves dinner' 0.15. One near miss of each is included on purpose.
